blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines ranked sixth out of 84 countries in mind health for adults aged 18 to 34, with a Mind Health Quotient (MHQ) score of 59, according to an analysis by Inquirer data scientist Dr. Rogelio Alicor Panao. Panao analyzed data from Washington-based nonprofit Sapien Labs’ Global Mind Health in 2025 Report, the annual report of the Global Mind Project, which tracks mind health and well-being among internet-enabled populations worldwide.
